body: COMPETITOR MATH APP BRAND CRITIQUE. Target: Khan Academy. Brand promise: anyone can learn anything. Visual language: muted greens and blues, lots of white space, very restrained. Voice: neutral and encouraging, never coaching. What they do well: mastery-based progression is pure product. Zero decorative elements. Progress is always visible. What does not work for Kai: neutral voice is wrong. Kai needs Marcus's coaching voice not a neutral tutor. KA says try again. Marcus says off target hit the hint. KA celebrates participation. MCM celebrates results. KA palette is safe: readable, accessible, passes all WCAG. MCM palette is bold: Detroit colors require more WCAG work but carry identity. The gap: KA has evidence for every decision. MCM has Marcus's judgment. For now that is enough but MCM needs instrumentation eventually. What I am keeping from KA: mastery progression before next topic, one concept per screen, always-visible progress. What I am explicitly rejecting: neutral voice, soft colors, effort celebration.
